test_title: PYST 23: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 26 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Average age of a group of 27 boys is 21 years. If a boy leaves the group, then the average age becomes 21.7 years. What is the age of the boy who left the group?
solution:
**Given:**

Average age of a group of 27 boys = 21 years

When a boy leaves, the new average age = 21.7 years

**Formula Used:**

Sum of ages of all boys = Average age × Number of boys

New average age = (Sum of ages of remaining boys) / (Number of remaining boys)

**Calculation:**

Initial sum of ages = 21 × 27

Initial sum of ages = 567

New sum of ages (after one boy leaves) = 21.7 × 26

New sum of ages = 21.7 × 26

New sum of ages = 564.2

Age of the boy who left = Initial sum of ages - New sum of ages

Age of the boy who left = 567 - 564.2

Age of the boy who left = 2.8 years

**The correct answer is option 2.**
